summary: Red River Bancshares filed an 8-K announcing a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share, payable June 18, 2026 to holders of record June 8, 2026. This is a routine capital return event with no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. The filing contains no unusual terms, premiums, or structural changes. As a standard dividend declaration, it does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
